scope: All 276 tradeable finished Enchanting outputs in the canonical AH guide

recipe_source.name: WotLKDB Enchanting skill 333
recipe_source.role: Exact WotLK 3.3.5 spell IDs, reagents, output item IDs, and minimum guaranteed output counts.

pricing_policy.baseline_role: Frozen non-circular ingredient bands or exact unlimited-vendor prices.
pricing_policy.crafted_input_role: Saved Evidence Pricing bands are the opportunity cost for tradeable crafted inputs consumed by an enchant recipe.
pricing_policy.vellum_role: Each scroll adds one exact cheapest compatible vellum, priced from that vellum's own deterministic two-output Inscription recipe.
pricing_policy.floor_role: Recipe floors are craftability diagnostics and do not set finished-output sale value.
